admission.justification: Disposable generated artifacts require one canonical skill tree and regeneration of its packaged projection, otherwise an edited copy can become a conflicting instruction authority.

applicability: The canonical skills tree and its declared generated packaged runtime projection.

evidence: Evidence: The L27 landing ran the sync route and recorded 6 sources x 9 copies rewritten plus the 9 packaged c-14 copies created, all ten byte-identical; the script's own check mode is the divergence report.

statement: The repository's skill tree is the canonical instruction source; its generated packaged runtime copy is produced by the repository's own sync script, so a copy edited in place is reported as divergence rather than accepted as a second source.
